title: NASA-UAP-D030, STS-80 Unidentified Object Image 1, 1996
doc_notes: This document is a descriptive record of a single photographic image captured by NASA astronauts during the STS-80 mission in 1996.

incidents.summary: Astronauts aboard Space Shuttle Columbia captured an image of an unidentified elongated white object in low-Earth orbit during the STS-80 mission.
incidents.quote: a small, bright, elongated white object
